review_evidence: README states that Leanduction generates usable recursors for nested inductive types and cites the 2026 PLDI nested-inductive-types work describing the algorithms.
The eight primary Lean files implement sparse parametricity/positivity/recursor generation and exercise it on nested inductive families.
Test and example files contain nontrivial inductive definitions and induction examples that are useful formal prior art rather than disposable fixtures.
summary: Reviewed Leanduction; retain its nested-inductive recursor generation development and formal examples.
